clientChange: Quiet user-initiated A/B run; B requests the license assigned on the server. No added auto-start, service, registry cache, local log or admin UI.
limits: Actual Windows/dcc64 compilation and end-to-end Windows run not executed here.
Necessary EXE and runtime memory remain. No claim to erase OS paging, dumps, traces or installed code.
Server cannot diagnose an execution that never reached it as a confirmed local cause.
Existing single-use license and machine restrictions remain. New issued A must have an unused assigned license; old unassigned A cannot auto-redeem with the new B.
Source cleanup does not delete archived production APK/member data. Shared referenced compatibility modules remain.
Jobs: 100 items per batch, 100 concurrent queued/running jobs, 1000 retained jobs. No automatic job-history purge.
Only unreferenced deployment candidates older than 7 days are cleanup candidates. All historical referenced files are retained.

cleanup.retainedText: Third-party license/provenance and actual TLS setup instructions are required and retained.

tests: Deploy opens with current A/B and no mutation
Public approval auto-fills version and role
Mismatched EXE is rejected before upload
Publish requires an explicit current preview and sends revisions
A failed quality panel does not block the job panel
Job preview is non-mutating, edits invalidate it and commit is explicit
Closing workspace stops browser polling, not server jobs
Unified detail escapes metadata and keeps the existing PC unblock action
Metadata save carries the server revision
License rows render without waiting for a stalled independent panel
Browser selection is session-bound RAM and is cleared on session change
No unhandled promise rejection in the exercised administrator paths
browser.scope: Chromium production JS + mock API/hash fixture; not Windows/real server integration or browser WebCrypto validation

sourceVerifier.scope: Temporary-copy corruption, deletion, retired-source, symlink, placement, manifest path tests

verification.referenceCheck: Literal relative require references all resolved; resource check via check-connect-project.js.
blockedDependencies: jpeg-js and related legacy image dependencies in module export probing
better-sqlite3 runtime for full SQLite suites
notExecuted: Complete SQLite and legacy jsdom suites
